title: Only idle interaction mode recorded, 7 other modes never triggered
detail: All 8 sessions only record interaction_modes=['idle']. The 7 untested modes are: buildMenu, buildPlace, towerSel, spawnMenu, spawnPlace, event, paused, wardenSelect. This means the autoplay controller performs all actions (build, upgrade, sell) without going through the normal UI state machine. While autoplay may bypass UI modes by design, this means: (1) UI state machine bugs are never caught, (2) mode transition bugs are untested, (3) the wardenSelect overlay flow is not exercised (warden is pre-selected), (4) pause/resume is never tested. The modeEvent path (random events) is also completely untested.

suggested_fix.description: Autoplay actions should go through the same interaction mode state machine as player input. BuildTower should transition idle->buildMenu->buildPlace->idle. SelectTower should use towerSel mode. Pause should be tested periodically. Random events should be enabled to exercise modeEvent. This would catch mode transition bugs.
